rows.text: The bike leans so far on the kickstand that I can't put groceries into the front box with both hands.
I'd like the user manual printed large enough for my parents to read.
It can stand on its own. I need the crate to stay put when I cycle over the curb.
When I bump the table even a little, the slide text goes soft. I'd like it to recover without turning the ring.
The bike wobbled around the corner outside the shop. I don't remember if I was still loading or already moving.
It stays square on the screen. The issue is the menu getting blurry whenever we move the projector closer.
不能正中摆放，投到墙上左边高右边低，想把原来完整的画面调回来。
从客厅挪到卧室后，字幕变糊，画面大小合适，能不能自己重新对焦？
移到会议桌另一头后，轮廓还是方的，就是小字虚了，想自动调回清楚。
Bread gets crushed when the parcels roll into it on the way home. I need a way to keep the items separated under way.
I wheel the unit out for each lesson. Please bring the writing back into focus after I park it at the new distance.
还没骑就差点翻，放个快递要一手抓车把；希望停车装卸能稳一点。
在坡一点的地方支架挂不住，抱着货没法腾手，想停车也能稳住车身。
上小坡后包一路往后滑，前面能加固定点系带吗？
机器只能放在沙发侧面，画面四角希望能对齐幕布，边上的文字也要看全。
城里室内拖鞋底太滑，刚拖过的瓷砖上走不稳。
装东西时车老往一边倒，想不用人扶也能在路边站稳。
Getting the child into the carrier is the difficult part. A stand should keep the parked bike level through that.
The image is sharp enough. I'd like to keep the whole rectangle on the wall when I can't aim the lens straight at it.
一人带货出门总担心车倒、箱子滑，两个问题还没遇到哪个更严重。
I can't tell whether I bumped the focus or just picked a bad place to put it. The whole thing looked wrong.
The projector remote has nearly identical buttons. I keep pressing the wrong one in the dark.
The bags slide across the cargo bed whenever I turn. A way to cinch them to the frame would help.
Once we're moving the load is fine. I want the bike to stay on its feet while I'm lifting the bag into the box.
车铃装在把横下面，戴手套伸过去很难拨响。
投得远一点就需要重新拧镜头，希望换位置能把焦点找准。
装得下也好停车，麻烦的是雨天急刹东西全往前挤，想隔一下或者固定起来。
Putting the projector on the ceiling gives us a trapezoid. I need the whole presentation visible without moving the bracket.
调了一晚上还是不行，方不方清不清都受影响，两样都想要。
停车倒是不晃，骑上石板路箱子就弹起来，想有地方把货绑住。
投影打斜了右下角跑到墙外，想校正到框内，没法搬柜子腾地方。
The only free shelf is to the side. From there, one edge of the movie gets cut off and the subtitles sit on a slant.
